The clippers to clip, tweezers to tweeze, filer to file... that's not necessarily the case. The clippers will cut your nails. As for the tweezers there is absolutely NO resistance. They completely close. I would def recommend anyone watching the previous video posted as a review. It's very accurate and my experience is the same

Did not come with the cuticle nippers, which was the reason for my purchase. Instead, it had a pair of sideways clippers, which are completely unnecessary because the kit already comes with 3 in various sizes. See photo.
They are not high end, but they are good.

reviews.t: It feels very nice and looks better in person than it does online
reviews.x: This is such an ultimate set of tools for pedicures, wow.  The case for this set is quite gorgeous. It feels very nice and looks better in person than it does online. It's a great size for all the tools included to fit neatly inside. I have had similar wallets that work like this case, however this is made much better than those. The clasp for the top to open and close the case is made well. The only issue I had with the case itself is the straps to hold the tools inside the case. It's made out

reviews.t: This is a great little manicure set that I have given to numerous ...
reviews.x: This is a great little manicure set that I have given to numerous friends and own myself.  it has nearly everything you need to trim fingernails and toes.  What i like about it so much is the handy compact case, small in size, and easy to throw into an overnight travel bag. The tweezers could be more sturdy, but do the trick in a pinch.  I would recommend it for manicurists as the tools can be sterilized.  It includes blackhead remover, pushers, trimmers, nail file, nail cuticle nippers, and oth

The main reason I purchased this set was for the sizzor-like clippers. However the ones I received were nothing like the picture and in fact just an over-sized clipper that didn't work. I was also disappointed to find that the sizzors, which also appeared nothing like the picture were so flimsy and useless they couldn't even cut tissue paper. The tweezers were also very flimsy, and could not grasp eyebrow hair well. As the set was only 10$ it wasn't worth returning. The other pieces in the set w

The set came without the mail cuticle nippers and had some unsharpened curved toe clippers instead! I bought another set exactly like this from SHANY and it was awesome, but this one was a dud. However, the additional tools and the nice case are why I'm going with two stars instead of one.
Everything looks good, except the scissors . The scissors is really bad quality, it cuts a paper but I won't use on my skin.

reviews.t: nice-looking case but manicure tools don't work
reviews.x: I had hoped that this set would be useful at home and for traveling, but the tweezers don't work at all to tweeze facial hair and what I thought were toenail clippers are too small to do the job.  My set did not come with the larger toenail scissors pictured, which was one of the primary reasons I bought this set instead of a different one.  The case is classy-looking in person and appears to work OK, but if the metal tools don't serve their intended purpose then the set is worthless to me.  I'v

This little manicure/pedicure set is handy as a travel set.  It has 12 different implements, or is it tools?, in it.  Some of them I don't even have an idea what they could be used for, but I think they could be handy in a pinch as "think outside the box" kind of implements (maybe eating oysters off the half shell? picking a lock?).  I like that everything is organized very neatly.  The nail and toenail clippers seem sturdy, but the little scissors don't look like they will hold up too w

reviews.t: The tools seem to be pretty sturdy as they can be
reviews.x: There were many different brands to choose from sets to choose from but I found this set to be very plentiful. Plus the unique design on the case was a plus. The set came with all 12 pieces as described. The tools seem to be pretty sturdy as they can be. The clippers are not dull at all and they all seem to get the job done. The 3 clippers have the cutest little smiley faces in them which I found to be a nice addition. If you purchased these separately you would definitely come a little more out

reviews.t: Presents for myself and my mom
reviews.x: It is a beautifully designed, tasteful pouch. However, it arrived missing 1 item (not sure which one) and it was stack together because of so many items. It is lightweight and does not do heavy duty work. I like all the instruments, though. I enjoy myself taking care of my nails. I ordered 2 pouches: one for myself and one for my mom. Her arrived just fine and was not missing anything.I was provided this product at a reduced price to complete and post a factual review without compensation. Posit

This is a very nice set of clippers.  I bought this set for my husband to use on his nails.  He really likes this set and uses it regularly.  We both love the case that holds all of  the pieces..  This would make a great gift for just about any guy or gal.  The assortment of pieces makes it easy to tackle those difficult nails and cuticles too.  What's  really nice about this set is that not only are all the pieces kept together in it's case, it keeps my husband from using MY clipper set.  I no

Nice travel size, all you need in a grooming kit, fits perfectly in your hand bag or glove compartment. The only problem is I used the small nail clipper for both fingers & toes but it seems my toenails were a little bit too strong or thick or now it's a little dull, I guess the small clipper are for you fingers and the large are for your toes but not everyone has a separate clipper for both. I love the black & gold pouch and all the items there in. Good purchase, reasonably priced.

I really like this set. I like that the case has the push button open and stays shut very well. I've opened and closed it many times. I have taken out all the tools and used quite a few. I do not have any issue with the resistance on any of them that I've tested out. The clippers and nippers all work as supposed to. The extra tools are nice for hard to reach areas etc. I have no complaints with this set. I like how everything is stored in one plac and the case is very cute.

I've purchased similar products at similar prices in the past that were good quality and durable. The same CANNOT be said for this item. All the tools are very Cheaply made, the case almost broke the very first time I tried to open it. As stated in other reviews, many of these tools do not work for their intended purpose, if at all. I will be buying a different set and will definitely not buy from this seller in the future.

I do a lot of traveling and I always end of needing something that is in this small case. I love this. It is small but yet contains 12 essential tools to ensure your manicure and pedicure needs can be done when you are on the road.  Each of the items are made very well. The case is very sturdy and holds all the tools in place. Will slip in my luggage very easily.

I don't know why anyone would complain about this set. The clippers are all sturdy and well made. The case is cute, but not high end. However, I think it will be sturdy enough to last a few years. There are tools that I have no idea what they are used for so a little guide would have been helpful. My experience in no way matches the lady with the video review.

If only,  right? If only a little more effort in quality were applied, I would be able to apply more stars. I haven't used any of the tools as of yet, so I can't speak of their quality. However, If the effort and consideration used in the decisions concerning the fit and fonish of this product were applies to the tools enclosed, i would be somewhat concerned.

reviews.t: Worth it. Great buy, great price.
reviews.x: What a gem. I got this item (3) for my toddler's teachers for Christmas and they loved it... so did I. The carrying case is beautiful and the set is complete. Stailess steel which is naturally beautiful. There are multiple tools, some which I dont even know what it is used for... HA! Honestly... you get much more for what you paid for. Great buy.

complete crap. sure, the tools "look cool" and its a great price. all the tools are super dull. the fingernail clippers bend the nail as it cuts. the mini scissors rip your hair out, not cut them. I contacted the seller at their request, and they told me, "well, you got your product on time, you can deal with Amazon now".

reviews.t: Great little set for a great price
reviews.x: Great little set for a great price! And gender neutral, too. Bought one for my youngest son, when my ex-husband saw it and loved it I bought one for him too. Has everything you need and a few things we havent quite figured out yet, too! Comes in a nice, simple white box so it really could be used as a nice little gift.

reviews.t: You get what you pay for
reviews.x: Where to start?  This product is incredibly low quality.  The little case doesn't close properly, the little latch seems like it will break after just  few uses, and the implements themselves are terrible.  For example, the nail clippers are so dull right out of the package that I couldn't even snip a little hangnail.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the tools cheap and flimsy, with scissors and clippers that don't work well.
Several reviewers report receiving the wrong or missing items compared to what was pictured, such as missing cuticle nippers.
Reviewers frequently praise the attractive, compact case that is handy for travel and gifting.
Some reviewers find the set good value for the price and adequate for light use.
A few reviewers note the tools are lightweight and not suited for heavy-duty work.
